name: Ghost Channel
mission: Sends data to a camera as faint screen flicker.
flowAlt: Data flow. On the sender page: a demo scene, image, video, webcam or shared screen is the picture; the payload is packed into a container, protected with Reed-Solomon and a fountain code; a WebGL2 shader adds a 20 Hz carrier whose phase carries two bits per cell. On the receiver page: the camera frames go to a Web Worker, the screen is found by its carrier power or by corners placed by hand, and the grid and symbol timing are locked with pilot cells. Then each cell is demodulated, errors are corrected, and a link is shown to open on tap or a file offered as a download.

nodes: fit DC, I and Q per cell
link opens only on a tap
